source_snapshot.procedure: Fully populate, stress CPU/DIMM/HDD for five minutes, remove and reapply AC, repeat ten times.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal recovery, expected AC-drop logs, no hang or lost device.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; physical loaded AC-drop cold/high-rail test.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds safe storage scope, steady-state proof, fixture timing, integrity and recovery.

old_problem: Pending values were target identity, load floor, fixture timing and per-drop oracle; the abrupt loaded-loss purpose is clear and parameterizable.
disposition_reason: ED-04 protects storage, ED-06 distinguishes abrupt AC drop from cycle/reboot, ED-09 keeps physical power work manual, ED-17 preserves evidence, ED-18 requires complete recovery, and no failed iteration may be retried automatically.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row45 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3082 and actual next row46/history3083 were read.
Each drop must occur only after a proven five-minute CPU/DIMM/safe-storage steady state, using approved disposable/non-destructive targets.
A rated interlocked fixture supplies explicit removal/reapply dwell; cable pulling is not an uncontrolled substitute.
Ten-entry evidence covers expected loss events, data integrity, full inventory and cold trace; no power action ran.

test_case.test_name: Ten loaded abrupt AC drops at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify a fully populated system survives ten abrupt AC removals during established CPU/DIMM/safe-storage load and recovers data, devices and services at cold/high-rail margin.
required_package: Full inventory and safe storage target/workload map
Rated AC-drop fixture with dwell/auto-power profile
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions, prove the approved load steady state for five minutes before each event, execute ten controlled fixture drops/reapplications, and after each verify expected loss logs, data integrity, inventory and readiness before continuing.
test_case.expected_result: All ten events occur at the signed load state, expected power-loss events appear, no data/device/service loss remains, and dry nominal restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires ten distinct loaded abrupt drops with per-event integrity and inventory. Graceful shutdown, unloaded cycling, unsafe writes, final boot only or a retried failure cannot pass.
safety_gate: Approved non-OS/non-mounted/non-RAID storage scope or non-destructive profile
Interlocked fixture rated for load/inrush and OOB access
Abort on data/device, electrical, moisture, thermal or boot fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
expected_evidence: Expected/unexpected events, integrity/inventory, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop after the first disallowed result, preserve data and event evidence, isolate power safely, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover/quarantine storage or devices and do not repeat the failed drop.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align on ten loaded abrupt AC drops.

blocked.reason: The operation is safely parameterized after target and fixture approval.
